metadata.purpose: Pass 113 four-element witness showing that the Pass-112 A2 gate is a three-element artifact. The order is the chain 0<a<b plus a second branch 0<c, with b incomparable with c. Under antitone-dual-lower-cut-v1, the MacNeille completion has a non-principal fixed cut and the original carrier has no syntactic boxtimes fixed point.
metadata.g2Explanation: G2 holds vacuously because boxtimes(top)=boxtimes(a)=b is not <= bottom=0, while A2 holds because top=a <= boxtimes(bottom)=b.
metadata.latticeStatus: non-lattice: b and c have no join in the four-element carrier
metadata.macneilleRole: The MacNeille completion adds the missing upper closure of the two branches; the whole carrier cut is closed and non-principal.
